proposal.explanation: Ranking prioritizes patches that directly target the mismatched output ports (scl_o, scl_t, sda_o, sda_t) at the failure cycles (23, 27, 28, 29) with structural dependencies on the failing state edges. Patches patch_3d82912c89bf, patch_f7e6f5f52970, and patch_422618d0dee5 directly modify scl_o_next or sda_o_reg with evidence tied to the failing port scl_o (cycle 23) and sda_o (cycle 27). patch_863a54b885b4 modifies scl_o_next using last_scl_i_reg, which is structurally related to scl_o edge detection. patch_de1628c0e786 modifies scl_o_next with s_axis_cmd_write, also dependent on the same failure cycle. The remaining patches address secondary signals (delay_scl_reg, phy_read_bit, phy_release_bus) that may influence timing but are less directly connected to the primary output mismatches.
